व्य्-अति-√ शॄ P. -शीर्यते (pr.p. -शीर्यत्), to burst into many pieces, MBh.

व्य्-अति-√ सृ only ind.p. -सृत्य, prob. ‘in each case’, ‘on every occasion’, MBh. xii, 4402 (गुरुम् अनु-सृत्य, Nīlak.) :
Caus. -सारयति (with कथाम्), to converse, Divyāv.
व्य्-अतिषक्त mfn. mutually connected or joined or related, intertwined, mixed together, TBr. &c. &c.
intermarried, intermarrying, MW.
व्य्-अतिषङ्ग m. mutual connection, reciprocal junction or relation, PañcavBr.; KātyŚr.
entanglement, Śiś. v, 61
hostile encounter, MBh.
exchange, barter, BhP.
absorption, MW.
व्य्-अतिषङ्ग—वत् mfn. having mutual connection, connected, united, mixed, ib.
व्य्-अतिष॑ङ्गम् ind. so as to join or connect mutually, ŚBr.
व्य्-अतिषङ्ग्˚इन् mfn. (ifc.) hanging or sitting on Śiś.
व्य्-˚अतिषज्य ind. seizing each other by the hand, PañcavBr.
व्य्-अतिषञ्जित mfn. = व्य्-अतिषक्त, Śiś., Sch.
व्य्-अतिषिक्त mfn. separated, ĀpY.
व्य्-अति-सं-√ दह् P. -दहति, to burn up entirely, ChUp.
व्य्-अति-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति (Pāṇ. i, 3, 15), to move to and fro, fly in every direction (as arrows), MBh.
व्य्-अति-√ सेव् Pass. -सेव्यते, to be well furnished or provided with (instr.), MBh. vii, 7297.

व्य्-अति-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to strike back or in return, MBh.; Bhaṭṭ.;
to strike each other, fight together, Pāṇ. i, 3, 15 : to kill together, Pat.
व्य्-अति-√ हस् P. -हसति, to laugh at each other, Pāṇ. i, 3, 15, Vārtt. 1, Pat.
व्य्-अति-√ हिंस् P. -हिंसति, to hurt or injure each other, Pāṇ. i, 3, 15, Sch.
व्य्-अति-√ हृ Ā. -हरते (Vop.), to transpose mutually, Gobh.
व्य्-अतिहार m. interchange, alternation, reciprocity, Pāṇ.; Vop.
exchange, barter, Kāṭh.
exchange of blows or abuse, W.
व्य्-अतीहार m. = व्य्-अतिहार, q.v.
व्यतीत mfn. passed away, gone, Mn.; MBh. &c.
departed, dead, MBh.
left, abandoned, Prab.
(ifc.) having disregarded or neglected, R.
tardy, negligent, ib.
व्यतीत—काल mfn. one whose time is past, unseasonable, inopportune, Ragh.

व्य्-अत्यय m. transposition, transmutation, change, reverse, inverted order, contrariety (with कर्मणाम्, inverted or reverse occupation; ए, in the opposite case; अम्, alternately; आत् and एन, against the usual rule rule or order), Lāṭy.; Yājñ.; Kāv. &c.
व्य्-अत्यय—ग mfn. moving in the opposite direction, VarBṛS.
व्य्-अतीक्षा f. (व्य्-अति-ईक्षा), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 43, Vārtt. 4.
व्य्-अतीहा f. (fr. व्य्-अति-√ ईह्), Pāṇ. iii, 3, 43, Vārtt. 4.
व्य्-अत्य्-√ अस् Ā. -अति-स्ते (1. sg. -अति-हे, 2. sg. -अति-से, Pāṇ. vii, 4, 50; 52), to be above, excel, surpass, Bhaṭṭ.
व्य्-अत्य्-अस्त mfn. (√ 2. अस्) thrown or placed in an inverted position, reversed, inverted, W.
placed across or crosswise, crossed (as the hands), Mn. ii, 72
perverse, preposterous, Bhām.
व्य्-अत्यास m. exchange, barter, Lāṭy.; MBh.
change, inverted order, reverse (एन and आत्, ‘invertedly, alternately’), VarBṛS.; Suśr.
व्य्-अत्यास्˚अ॑म् ind. alternating, alternately, ŚBr.; ŚrS.
having inverted, having placed crosswise, MW.
व्य्-अत्य्-√ ऊह् P. -ऊहति, to place or arrange differently, Kāṭh.
व्यथ See जल-व्यथ.
व्यथा॑ f. agitation, perturbation, alarm, uneasiness, pain, anguish, fear, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (व्यथां-√ कृ, either, ‘to cause pain’ or ‘to feel pain’)
loss, damage, ill-luck, ŚBr.; VarBṛS.
(with हृदि or हृदये), palpitation, throbbing of the heart, Suśr.
व्यथक mfn. agitating, frightening, afflicting, Kir.
व्यथन mfn. greatly disturbing or perplexing, MBh.
व्यथन n. tottering, wavering, Pāṇ. v, 4, 46
alteration, change (of a sound), RPrāt.
feeling pain, Suśr.
vexing, tormenting, Dharmaś.
piercing, perforating (= व्यधन), Āpast.
व्यथनीय mfn. to be pained or afflicted or disturbed, W.
व्यथयितृ mfn. (fr. Caus.) one who inflicts torture or punishment, Mṛcch.
व्यथा—कर mfn. causing pain (bodily or mental), painful, excruciating, W.
व्यथा˚कुल (व्यथाक्˚), mfn. agitated by fear or anguish, Pañcat.
व्यथा˚क्रान्त (व्यथाक्र्˚) mfn. id., Kathās.
व्यथा˚तुर (व्यथात्˚), mfn. suffering pain, pained, R.
व्यथा˚न्वित (व्यथान्व्˚), mfn. id., MW.
व्यथा—रहित mfn. free from pain, W.
व्यथा—वत् mfn. full of pain, MW.
व्यथि See अ-व्यथि॑.
व्यथित॑ mfn. tottering, rocking, reeling, R.
troubled, changed (as colour), Daś.
disquieted, agitated, perturbed, distressed, afflicted, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
painful, causing pain, BhP.
व्यथितव्य mfn. to be pained or distressed, MW.
व्यथिन् See अ-व्यथिन्.
व्यथिष See अ-व्यथिष.
व्य॑थिस् mfn. tottering, wavering, sloping, RV.
secret, unobserved by (gen.), ib.
insidious, fallacious, deceitful, ib.; AV. (accord. to some always n. = ‘way, course’)
व्य॑थिस् n. perturbation, anger, Naigh. ii, 13.
व्यथ्य See अ-व्यथ्य॑.
व्यथ्ययस् w.r. for अ-व्यथ॑यस् (see अ-यथि॑), Naigh. i, 14.
व्य्-√ अद् P. -अत्ति, to bite through or on all sides, gnaw, nibble, eat, R.
व्य्-अद्वर॑ m. (f(व्य्-अ॑द्वरी). , AV.) a gnawing animal, ŚBr. (cf. व्यध्वर॑).
व्यद्य n. a partic. Sūkta, Kauś.
व्यध m. piercing, hitting, striking, a stroke, wound, Śiś.
cutting, opening (of a vein), Suśr.
व्यधा f. bleeding, MW.
व्याध m. ‘one who pierces or wounds’, a hunter, one who lives by killing deer (said to be the son of a Kṣatriya by a low-caste mother), Mn.; MBh. &c.
a low man, wicked person, L.
व्याध &c. See √ व्यध्, p. 1031.

व्य्-आ-√ 1. धा -धीयते to be separated or divided, Br.;
to be out of health, feel unwell, ChUp.
व्यधन mfn. piercing, perforating, Suśr.
व्यधन n. the act of piercing or perforating or severing (a vein), ib.
(ifc.) chase, hunting, Hcar.
व्यध्य mfn. to be pierced or perforated, Suśr. (-सिर mfn. one who is to be bled, ib.)
a bowstring, L.
a butt, mark to shoot at, W.
व्याध्य mfn. to be pierced or cut (as a vein), Suśr.
व्याध्य m. N. of Śiva, MBh. vii, 2877 (v.l. व्याध).
व्यध्य—सिर mfn., one who is to be bled, ib.
व्यध्वर॑ mfn. piercing, perforating, boring (as a worm), AV. (cf. व्य्-अद्वर॑).
व्याध—गीति f. a hunter's cry (in calling animals), Kād.
व्याध—ता f. the state or business of a hunter, Viṣṇ.
व्याध—भीत m. ‘afraid of hunters’, a deer, W.
व्याधक m. a hunter, Kauś.
व्याधाय Nom. Ā. ˚यते, to become or be like a hunter, Śṛṅgār.
व्याधि See व्य्-आधि, p. 1037, col. 1.
व्य्-आधि m. (less probably from √ व्यध्, p. 1031) disorder, disease, ailment, sickness, plague (esp. leprosy), ChUp.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
Disease personified (as a Child of Mṛtyu or Death), VP.
any tormenting or vexatious person or thing (ifc., e.g. स्त्री-व्˚, a plague of a woman, very troublesome woman), VarBṛS.
Costus Speciosus or Arabicus, L.
व्य्-आ᳙-धी f. (√ 1. धी, or ध्यै) care, sorrow, AV.
1. व्याधि॑न् mfn. piercing, perforating, VS.
2. व्याधिन् mfn. (fr. व्यध) possessing (i.e. frequented by) hunters, Nalod.
3. व्याधिन् mfn. (for 1, and 2. See p. 1031, col. 2) id., MW.
व्यधिक (prob. w.r. for ह्य्-अधिक), Kām.
व्य्-अधि-क्षेप m. (√ क्षिप्) invective, harsh language, MBh.

व्य्-√ अन् P. -अनिति, to respire, breathe, inhale and exhale, RV.;
to draw in the breath through the whole body, ŚBr.
व्य्-आन m. one of the five vital airs (that which circulates or is diffused through the body; personified as a son of Udāna and father of Apāna; cf. प्राण), AV. &c. &c.
व्य्-आन &c. See व्य्-√ अन्, p. 1031.
व्य्-आन—दा॑ mfn. giving breath, VS.
व्य्-आन—दृ॑ह् mfn. (nom. -धृ॑क्) making the Vyāna strong or durable, TS.; Kāṭh.
व्य्-आन—भृ॑त् mfn. maintaining the Vyāna, ŚBr.
व्य्-आ˚नोदान॑ m. du. Vyāna and Udāna, AV.
व्य्-अनु-√ धा (only 3. pl. pf. Ā. -धिरे), to unfold, display, RV. i, 166, 10.
व्य्-अनु-√ नद् Caus. -नादयति, to cause to resound, fill with noise or cries, Bhag.
व्य्-अनु-˚नाद m. reverberation, loud and extending sound or noise, W.

व्य्-अनु-√ सृ P. -सरति, to roam or wander through (acc.), MBh.;
to pervade, Suśr.
व्य्-अन्व्-आ-√ रभ् Ā. -रभते, to lay hold of or touch on both sides, AitBr.
व्य्-अन्व्-˚आरम्भण n. laying hold of or touching on both sides, Sāy.

व्यप् (v.l. व्यय् See 2. व्यय्) cl. 10. P. व्यापयति, to throw, Dhātup. xxxii, 95;
to throw away, waste, diminish (cf. व्यय्), L.

व्य्-√ आप् P. -आप्नोति (rarely Ā. -आप्नुते), to reach or spread through, pervade, permeate, cover, fill, AV. &c. &c.;
to reach as far as, extend to, L. (cf. Pāṇ. v, 2, 8) :
Pass. व्य्-आप्यते (see व्याप्यमान) :
Caus. व्य्-आपयति (see व्य्-आपित) :
Desid. वीप्सति (see वीप्स).
व्य्-अपा-√ कृष् (only inf. -क्रष्टुम्), to drag or draw away, tear off, MBh.
व्य्-˚अपकर्ष m. exception (from a rule), Pat.
व्य्-˚अपकृष्ट mfn. drawn off, taken away, removed, MBh.
व्य्-अप-√ क्रम् P. -क्रामति, to go off retire, depart, R.

व्य्-अप-√ गम् P. -गच्छति, to go away, retreat, escape, disappear, MBh.; Kāv. &c.;
to move away from, be entirely removed or distant, VarBṛS.
व्य्-अप-˚गत mfn. gone away, disappeared (see comp.)
fallen away from (abl.), R.
व्य्-अप-˚गत—तिलकगात्र-ता f. the having limbs free from freckles (one of the 80 minor marks of a Buddha), Dharmas. 84
व्य्-अप-˚गत—रश्मि-वत् mfn. whose rays have disappeared, ray less, Sūryas., Sch.
व्य्-अप-˚गत—शुच् mfn. whose sorrow his departed, free from grief, MW.
व्य्-अप-˚गम m. passing away, lapse (of time), Kull. on Mn. v, 66
disappearance, Amar.
व्य्-अप-√ त्रप् Ā. -त्रपते (rarely ˚ति), to turn away through shame, become shy or timid, MBh.; R.
व्य्-अप-˚त्राप्य (?) n. id., Divyāv.

व्य्-अप-√ दिश् P. -दिशति, to point out, indicate, intend, mean, designate, name, mention, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (often Pass. -दिश्यते, ‘so it is represented or intended or signified’);
to represent falsely, feign, pretend, MBh.; R.; Prasannar.
व्यपदिष्ट mfn. pointed out &c.
informed, W.
tricked, ib.
pleaded as an excuse, ib.
व्य्-अपदेश m. representation, designation, information, statement, RPrāt.; ŚrS. &c.
a name, title, Uttarar.
a family, race, Śak.
summons (of an army), R.
appeal to (gen.), Pañcat.
talk, speech, MBh. iii, 8665 (Nīlak.)
a partic. form of speech, MW.
fame, renown (see comp.)
fraud, stratagem, pretext, excuse (एन, under pretext or excuse [also -तस्] ifc. = under the pretext of), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
व्य्-अपदेश—वत् mfn. having a partic. designation or name (with पितृ-तस्, designated by the name of the father), Pat.
व्य्-अपदे˚शार्थम् ind. for the purpose of (acquiring) renown, Mn. vii, 168.
व्य्-अपदे˚शक mfn. designating, indicating, BhP.
व्य्-˚अपदेशिन् mfn. having a name or designation, L.
(ifc.) denoting, indicating, Śaṃk.
(ifc.) conforming to, following the advice of R.
व्य्-˚अपदेश्य mfn. to be designated or indicated or named, R.; Pat.; Śaṃk.
to be censured or blamed, Hariv.
व्य्-˚अपदेष्टृ mfn. one who represents or shows or names, W.
one who represents falsely, a cheat, impostor, ib.
व्य्-अप-√ दृश् Pass. -दृश्यते, to be clearly seen, be distinctly visible, MBh.
व्य्-अप-√ नश् Caus. -नाशयति to cause to disappear or perish, drive away, remove, MBh.
व्य्-अपनय m. taking away, removal, MBh. (v.l. व्य्-अपयन).
व्य्-˚अपनयन n. tearing off, removing, Veṇīs.
व्य्-अपनीत mfn. led off, taken away, removed, R.
व्य्-˚अपनेय mfn. to be taken away or removed, MBh.
व्य्-अप-√ नुद् P. -नुदति, to drive away, remove, MBh.
व्य्-अपा-√ नुद् (अपा m.c. for अप) P. -नुदति, to drive away, remove, MBh.
व्य्-अप˚नुत्ति f. driving away, removal, AitBr.
व्य्-अप-√ मुच् P. -मुञ्चति, to loosen, take off, R.

व्य्-अप-√ या P. -याति, to go away, retire, withdraw, MBh.; Hariv.;
to pass away, vanish, R.
व्य्-अपाय m. cessation, stop, end, MBh.; R. &c.
absence, want, Kathās.
व्य्-अप-˚यात mfn. gone away, retired, MBh.
व्य्-˚अपयान n. retreat, flight, ib.
व्य्-अप-√ रुध् (only 2. sg. Intens. -रोरुधः), to exclude from sovereignty, dethrone, R. (B.)
व्य्-अपरोपण n. rooting up, extirpating, removing, destroying, Kām.; Sarvad.
tearing out, pulling (cf. केश-व्य्˚).
व्य्-˚अपरोपित mfn. rooted up, extirpated, removed, expelled, W.
व्य्-अप-वह् See व्य्-अपोह्.
व्य्-अप-विद्ध mfn. (√ व्यध्) thrown about, broken to pieces (-बृशी-मठ mfn. with abandoned seats and cells), MBh.
cast away, rejected, MBh.
pierced, transfixed, MBh.
व्य्-अप-विद्ध—बृशी-मठ mfn., with abandoned seats and cells
व्य्-अप-वृज् Caus. -वर्जयति, to give up entirely, relinquish, Ragh.
व्य्-अपवर्ग m. separation, division, difference, Pat.
cessation, termination, Jaim.
व्य्-अपवृक्त mfn. separated, divided, Pat.
व्य्-अप-√ वृत् Ā. -वर्तते, to turn away, desist from (abl.), Uttarar.
व्य्-अप-सं-√ सृ (only ind.p. -सृत्य), to go through (a series of existences), Divyāv.

व्य्-अप-√ सृ P. -सरति, to go asunder or in different directions, MBh.;
to depart from (abl.), Sarasv.
व्य्-˚अपसारण n. (fr. Caus.) driving away, dispelling, Rāghav.

व्य्-अप-√ सृज् P. -सृजति, to hurl, cast, discharge (arrows &c.), MBh.;
to take off, relinquish (a garment), ib.
व्य्-अप-√ सृप् P. -सर्पति, to go or creep or run away, escape, MBh.
व्य्-अप-√ स्फुर् Ā. -स्फुरते, to break (intr.) or burst asunder, KātyŚr., Sch.
व्य्-˚अपस्फुरण n. bursting asunder, KātyŚr.

व्य्-अप-√ हन् P. -हन्ति, to strike off, R. (B.);
to keep off, prevent, Sāh.
व्य्-अप-√ हा (only ind.p. -हाय), to relinquish, abandon, Hariv.

व्य्-अप-√ हृ P. Ā. -हरति, ˚ते, to cut off, MBh.;
to take away, remove, destroy, Rājat.
व्य्-अपा-√ हृ P. -हरति, to withdraw from (abl.), MBh.
व्य्-अपा-कृत mfn. (√ 1. कृ) free from (comp.), Naiṣ.
व्य्-˚अपाकृति f. driving away, repelling, denial, W.

व्य्-अपा-√ श्रि P. Ā. -श्रयति, ˚ते, to go to for refuge, have recourse to (acc.), MBh.;
to adhere to any doctrine, confess (acc.), Śaṃk.
व्य्-˚अपाश्रित mfn. one who has taken refuge with (acc. or comp.), MBh.; Kathās.
having taken or assumed, MBh.; BhP.

व्य्-अपे (-अप- √ 5. इ) P. -अपैति, to go apart or asunder, separate, MBh.;
to cease, disappear, Mn.; Prab.
व्य्-अपेत mfn. gone apart or asunder, separated, MBh.
passed away, disappeared, ceased, Mn.; MBh. &c.
(ifc.) opposed to, Yājñ.
व्य्-अपेत—कल्मष mfn. having taint or guilt removed, free from sin, Mn. iv, 260
व्य्-अपेत—घृण mfn. devoid of compassion, pitiless, Amar.
व्य्-अपेत—धैर्य mfn. one who has abandoned firmness, MBh.
व्य्-अपेत—भय mfn. free from fear, ib.
व्य्-अपेत—भी mfn. free from fear, ib.
व्य्-अपेत—मद-मत्सर mfn. free from infatuation and selfishness, Yājñ.
व्य्-अपेत—हर्ष mfn. devoid of joy, R.
व्य्-अपेक्ष् (-अप-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -अपेषते, to look about, look for, regard, mind, pay regard or attention to (acc.), R.; Ragh.
व्य्-˚अपेक्ष (ifc.) See ˚अपेक्षा below.
व्य्-˚अपेक्षा f. regard, consideration (ifc. regarding, minding), MBh.; R. &c.
looking for, expectation (ifc. expectant of), BhP.; Kathās.
requisite, supposition (see स-व्य्˚)
application, use, W.
(in gram.) rection, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 1, Sch.
the mutual application of two rules, W.
व्य्-˚अपेक्षक mfn. mindful of (comp.), MBh.
व्य्-˚अपेक्षण n. looking for, expectation, regard, consideration, W.
व्य्-˚अपेक्षणीय mfn. to be looked for or expected, ib.
व्य्-˚अपेक्षित mfn. looked for, expected, MW.
mutually expected or looked to, ib.
mutually related
employed, applied, ib.
व्य्-˚अपेक्ष्य mfn. to be looked for or expected, ib.
व्य्-˚अपोढ mfn. driven away, removed, destroyed (˚ढाभ्र mfn. having the clouds driven away), MBh.
manifested, displayed, exhibited, ib.
opposite, contrary, reverse, W.
व्य्-˚अपोढाभ्र mfn., having the clouds driven away
व्य्-˚अपोह m. driving away, keeping off, removal, destruction, MBh.; Suśr.
denial, negation, Sāh.
